decisions.reason: Despite two years without website visibility, this certified plate heat exchanger line is very close to the core portfolio and capabilities, so with industry growth and some organizational slack management would more likely retain it unless sales clearly fell below aspiration.

Its earlier indication of a major market share in marine water cooling puts it above aspiration, and the later lack of website mention is more plausibly a presentation change than a failure for such an established adjacent product.

After several years with no visible follow-up evidence, this marine cooling unit appears to have weaker support than the firm's stronger marine cooling offers, so a boundedly rational management would likely reallocate resources to better-performing lines and new development.

The compact oil cooler remains close enough to the existing engineering and service base that management would usually continue it, although the absence of later visibility raises some concern that results may only be around or slightly below aspiration.

As an R&D-linked improvement product, enhanced tubes can be absorbed into broader exchanger offerings, so even without later website prominence the firm has reason to keep them while exploiting internal learning and installed-base advantages.
